# `connectome_flow_replication`

the run-to-run replication of the flow through the fibre network - per atom the correlation of two runs' edge flows over the joined and the not-joined pairs.

Version 1, scope `subject`. Run it with `nxr-neuro run connectome_flow_replication --dataset <folder> --subject <id> ...`; `nxr-neuro run connectome_flow_replication --help` prints the same options.

Examples:

```
nxr-neuro run connectome_flow_replication --dataset D --subject S --first RUN1_STEM --second RUN2_STEM --network BUNDLE_tiles32
```

## Inputs

| input | what it is | required |
|---|---|---|
| `first_spectra` | statistic any, where {"name": "$first"} (the chunk spectra one run's connectome flow read (its measurements are of them)) | yes |
| `second_spectra` | statistic any, where {"name": "$second"} (the chunk spectra the other run's connectome flow read) | yes |
| `atoms` | selection any, where {"name": "$atoms"} (the frequency atoms both runs were read with) | yes |
| `first` | measurement mean_edge_flow, of first_spectra, over atoms (one run's connectome flow: its mean edge flow per pair and atom (`nxr-neuro run connectome_flow` first)) | yes |
| `second` | measurement mean_edge_flow, of second_spectra, over atoms (the other run's, on the same network and atoms) | yes |
| `pairs` | statistic any, where {"name": "${network}_pairs"} (the fibre network (`nxr-neuro run tile_network` first)) | yes |

## Parameters

Each is an option `--<name> VALUE` (dashes for underscores; the value is read as YAML) or `--set NAME=VALUE`.

| parameter | option | default | unit | choices | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `first` | `--first` | none | - |  | the chunk spectra one run's connectome flow read, by name |
| `second` | `--second` | none | - |  | the chunk spectra the other run's read, by name |
| `atoms` | `--atoms` | none | - |  | the frequency atoms' kernel set by name (both runs') |
| `network` | `--network` | none | - |  | the stem of the fibre network's names |
| `min_streamlines` | `--min-streamlines` | `10` | streamlines |  | a pair is joined when at least this many streamlines join it (nxr: 10) |
| `name` | `--name` | `{first}_{second}_replication` | - |  | the stored statistic's name |

## The chain of nodes

| phase | node | in | with | out |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| before | [`stats.run_replication`](../nodes.md) | first=first, second=second, pairs=pairs | min_streamlines=$min_streamlines | replication |

`before` steps run once, `chunks` steps run on every chunk of the recording, `after` steps run once on what the chunks accumulated.

## Outputs

| output | stored as |
|---|---|
| `replication` | kind statistic, name $name, of first_spectra |

## Notes from the definition

```text
THE RUN-TO-RUN REPLICATION OF THE FLOW THROUGH THE FIBRE NETWORK (spec docs/specs/2026-11-24-connectome-flow.md): nxr's replication, the correlation of two runs' mean edge flows
per atom over the joined pairs and over the not-joined pairs, from two `connectome_flow` results on the same network and atoms.

What it cannot resolve: a correlation of two runs says the pattern repeats, not that the fibres carry it (the not-joined pairs' correlation is the comparison).

  nxr-neuro run connectome_flow_replication --dataset D --subject S --first RUN1_STEM --second RUN2_STEM --network BUNDLE_tiles32
```
